title: "Summarize both of the essays" dispatches Coder instead of answering from the essay knowledge
body:
Owner, 2026-10-01, TestFlight 42 (chat worker c59ec00d1a, after #10099): "summarize both of the essays, please" → "we need to dispatch Coder to read the essay files on the computer, or you can paste their text directly here." The essays are in the knowledge base (openagents.ttc-* and openagents.gen-* entries, overview + per-section); #10099's 28 labeled rows covered questions about what the essays say, not requests to summarize/explain/compare "the essays", "your essays", "both essays", "the general agents essay", "the test-time capabilities essay".

Fix: route essay summary/overview/comparison requests to product.kb and answer from both overview entries (a summary of each essay with links), not work.dispatch; generalize the rubric so "our essays/posts/writing" means the published essays in our knowledge, not files on a computer. Labeled rows incl. near misses ("summarize the README in my repo" → dispatch; "summarize this file" → dispatch), recalibrate per the router docs, keep held-out precision at current levels, bounded Jev spend; redeploy coder-worker-chat; also fix the known gap from #10099 ("what makes a claim externally validated?" → product.kb). Live-check on phone and desktop surfaces: "summarize both of the essays", "summarize your essay on general agents", "what are your essays about?", "compare the two essays" → grounded summaries; "summarize the README in this repo" → still dispatches.
